TNK PROGRESSION — 1.1.7

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge 21.1.262 · Java 21

28 new quest titles

  • Completionist: Dreadbane, Master of Trades, Roadwarden, Polymath, Eye Collector, Trophyforger, and Grand Completionist.
  • Side chapter finales: Trailblazer, Quartermaster, Hearthkeeper, Guild Merchant, Stargazer, Thaumaturge, Sky Captain, Machinist, Winterbound, Boss Hunter, and Forgehand.
  • Boss quests: Frostbreaker, Skybreaker, Cursebane, Wildbane, Ironbreaker, Deepslate Warden, Oathkeeper, Dunebane, Bastionbreaker, and Rootbreaker.

Each new title has an original pixel badge for the cosmetic slot. Chapters I–X of The Story retain their existing titles and reward IDs.

Existing worlds and quest rewards

  • The title catalog picks up missing new entries at startup. Earned titles, saved selections, character XP, and custom definitions carry over.
  • FTB Quests can award the new titles through Command rewards using tnkprogress title earn {p} <id> with permission level 2. The guide includes the quest names, IDs, and exact commands.
